Career Objectives
My career objective is to secure a role in a dynamic and growth-focused company, leveraging my 3+ years of experience and strong organizational and technical skills to drive the company’s success. I have managed payroll records for over 1,000 employees and have a proven track record of collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams and service providers.
Professional Summary
Payroll Executive with over 3 years of experience in ADP, Garnishments, Calsavers as well as Quickbooks. In addition to this 10 months of experience in Sales.
Work Experience
Payroll Executive
GCSM CONSULTANT PVT. LTD., Kolkata, West Bengal
September 2021 – Present
Calculating hours manually and inputting hours on Excel and then entering data on ADP and successfully doing the payroll for the company in US on a weekly basis with all the audit tasks as well as emails. Doing the Payroll for the team here in Kolkata as well with handling other HR tasks sometimes.
Sales Executive
Fusion BPO Services, Kolkata, West Bengal 
July 2021 – September 2021
Managed to onboard teachers as well as students willing to teach and to learn respectively for companies like LIDO & Cuemaths.
Process Associate
Teleminds Infotech Pvt. Ltd., Kolkata, West Bengal 
March 2021 – June 2021
I had an Excellent experience working as an AUSTRALIAN ENERGY Telesales Profile for Both Outbound & Inbound.
Customer Representative
Fusion BPO Services, Kolkata, West Bengal 
September 2019 – November 2021
I started my career as a customer representative working for a brand like OYO and it was an inbound process. I used to sell rooms or flats on monthly rent basis to the customers in need for PG’s, etc.
Education
Bachelor of Commerce in Accounting
University of Calcutta, Kolkata, West Bengal 
Graduated August 2016
Skills
ADP Workforce Now
ADP Ireports
Quickbooks
Garnishments
Calsavers
ACA
Guard Card Tracking
Auditing
